subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Rules need to be clear, but people's situations may be different.”?
options: A dark screen may hide laziness, but it may also hide a real problem.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
The alarm disturbed the class, but it also taught them to ask before judging.
It should also answer "Should we do this here, and who might be affected?"
